after:
- name: Bind the release commit into the published manifest
        env:
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "$RELEASE_SHA" in
            *[!0-9a-f]*|'') exit 1 ;;
          esac
          test "${#RELEASE_SHA}" -eq 40
          npm pkg set "gitHead=$RELEASE_SHA"

      - name: Pack and verify release bytes
        env:
          RELEASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-package"
before:
- name: Pack and verify release bytes
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="$RUNNER_TEMP/npm-package"
